decisive_spans.text: invagination of the descending colon into the sigmoid colon consistent with intussusception

response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states "invagination of the descending colon into the sigmoid colon consistent with intussusception," which directly supports D4 and D2. D4 is more specific to the colon, which is mentioned in the vignette. D7 (Lipoma) is contradicted by the description of an exophytic mass with surface exudates and erosions, as lipomas are typically smooth and fatty. D3 and D8 (Sigmoid colon cancer, Colorectal cancer) are contradicted by the normal carcinoembryonic antigen level. D6 (Inflammatory bowel disease) is contradicted by the presence of a distinct mass and the denial of weight loss and appetite changes.
